issues: Every section below the featured items (house rules, departments, story, totals, gallery, quote, CTA) rendered as empty paper: the scroll-reveal hid content with clip-path until an IntersectionObserver fired, so full-page captures, fast scrolls and no-scroll visitors saw thousands of px of blank roll (also the CTA gap on catalog)
Hero dot-matrix headline: line-height 1.04 let the --c-primary accent block overlap the glyph descenders of the line above ('waar', 'power.'), so it read as a rendering bug
Brand tagline stamp was mix-blend multiply over a grayscale photo, so on dark hero images (Brinks) it vanished into an empty outline
Only one --c-primary stamp on the whole page; after the hero the paper feels sterile, with none of the warmth the art direction asks for
No paper curl: the roll ends in a flat zigzag and there's no slot shadow under the printer head
Creativity 7, typography 6.5, layout/rhythm 4 (blank roll), polish 5, brand robustness 7, mobile 6, generic-ness: low; the receipt concept is strong but undermined by the empty sections
fixed: Reveal rewritten so content is always printed and the stepped feed animation only plays (animation-fill backwards) when a section intersects, on both template.html and catalog.html. No more blank paper
Headline line-height raised to 1.16 with accent padding tuned so the primary block sits cleanly behind its own line
Hero stamp now uses an opaque paper ground (no multiply) with a halftone mask, so it reads on any photo and in any brand colour
Added a second rotated 'Freshly printed ★' --c-primary stamp straddling the tear line above Today's items, which thunks in when the section prints
Paper curl: shadow where the strip leaves the printer slot, and the roll's torn end lifts with a 3D rotateX, shaded underside and contact shadow on the counter
